newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner launches Web sports site.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner launches Web sports site.

text.p: Time Warner Inc said Wednesday it would launch a sport site on the World Wide Web, using content from units CNN, Sports Illustrated, Turner Sports and CNN/SI, the company's 24-hour sports news network.

The site, CNNSI.com, will launch July 17 with more than 100,000 pages of domestic and international content, including proprietary content from Sports Illustrated, real-time statistics, local sports sections, and sports games.
The company said the site is produced in collaboration with CNN Interactive and The Pathfinder Network which is produced and operated by Time Inc New Media.
